final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT cr.raceId, r.name, AVG(cr.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM constructorResults AS cr JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cr.raceId WHERE cr.points > 1.0 GROUP BY cr.raceId, r.name), step2 AS (SELECT name, AVG(avg_points) AS name_avg_points FROM step1 GROUP BY name) SELECT s1.raceId, s1.name, s1.avg_points, s1.record_count, s1.avg_points / NULLIF(s2.name_avg_points, 0) AS ratio FROM step1 AS s1 JOIN step2 AS s2 ON s1.name = s2.name ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10
